the structure of the network is important for understanding the dynamics of the system.
the structure of a network is important in the evolution of its dynamics and that a thorough understanding is achieved by the study of both.

the development of new mathematical models and methods that will allow us to understand, predict, and control the complex dynamics of social, technological and biological systems.
the study of the dynamics and structure of complex networks.
the study of complex systems, which are characterized by a large number of interacting components.

the study of complex systems is a study of the dynamics of complex systems.
the architecture of complexity is the network of interactions.

we have found a new approach to understanding complex systems by combining the analysis of network structure and network dynamics.
the study of complex networks has provided a rich set of data sets and analytical tools that are now facilitating the study of complex systems.
